text:
ravi: Throwing another idea into the ring: lease-free optimistic allocation with reconciliation. Edges assume small safe allotment per tenant and reconcile with central every 500ms. Less RPC overhead, but requires good reconciliation and abuse detection hooks.

elaine: reconciliation sounds painful at scale. what about the cost of rollbacks?

ravi: rollbacks are local throttles; we keep per-tenant operation ids so we can revert credits and attribute overspend.

noah: how do we handle coordinated attacks where attacker spreads requests across many edges to game the optimistic allotment?

ravi: add abuse classifier upstream at ingest + cross-edge correlation. if cross-edge anomaly detected, central can bump tenant to strict-mode which requires explicit lease for each pull.

infra-bot: [metrics] optimistic-allotment sim (5k tenants) -> reduced central rps by 62% but p99 overshoot increased by 12% under partition. details: https://ci.internal/sim/opt-5000

elaine: OK tradeoff. let's document modes: optimistic (low cost, higher risk), lease (safer, higher cost), strict (heavy). owners: ravi+noah to draft RFC.

ravi: will do.
